title: Review: Zero Parades: Director's Cut (PS5) - A Riveting Spy Thriller That Still Lacks Disco Elysium's Bite
summary:
The devil is in the details.

I’m on sub-level three of a long-abandoned rocket silo, reading heavily redacted files by flashlight. Most of the screen is black, save for a little pang of light from my torch, and my heart beats rapidly as I comb through reams of text on the right of the screen.

It’s not flashy nor is it a massive spectacle, and it’s taken me hours to get to this point. However, it may be one of the most engrossing gaming moments I’ve had on PS5 this year.
